# ZarSignal — زرسیگنال

Persian market dashboard for gold, silver and currencies.
This is an early development version. Demo prices are not market quotations.
The proprietary bubble formula and price forecasts are not configured.

## Public information
- [Methodology](/methodology): data freshness, units and pending model status.
- [API documentation](/developers): versioned contracts and access requirements.
- [Subscription roadmap](/pricing): planned features, not an active checkout.

Never treat demo data or unconfigured analyses as investment recommendations.
